entities.name: Mun Ik-chŏm
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mun Ikchŏm  was a politician and Neo-Confucian scholar of the Goryeo period, who was primarily known for introducing cotton to Korea. His original given name was Ikch'ŏm, his courtesy name was Ilsin, and his art names were Saŭn and Samudang.
